macros.name: langnative
macros.doc: This macro may be used to print the native name of the language in its own script.

macros.name: lfam
macros.doc: The \lfam command prints the name of the language and its family in parenthesis.

macros.name: lname
macros.doc: The simplest macro is \lname, which prints out the name of the specified language according to the code provided.

macros.name: newlang
macros.doc: This macro defines new macros for a language from three mandatory arguments.

macros.name: newlangnative
macros.doc: This macro is the native counterpart to the \newlang macro, adding a new language to the native dataset.
